minimal_mitigation: Set MemoryMaxUsedVirtual to non-zero value (recommended 30500 MiB per COOK_MEMORY_BUDGET_DERIVATION.json) to enable commit throttling. This is the minimal change that addresses the root cause of SYSTEM_COMMIT_PRESSURE by preventing UE4Editor commit from unbounded growth. SCW memory bypasses cook accounting but commit throttling at the UE4Editor level provides system-wide protection.
notes: DISTINCT_RUNS=true: Three separate cook sessions/events with different dates (2026-10-04/05/11), different terminal conditions (OOM crash, hang, fatal write error), and different package high-water marks (2942, 2975, 3103). No observations from different runs were combined into one causal narrative. Telemetry invalidation: Sys_Commit_MB = Sys_CommitLimit_MB on every COOK_RESOURCE_TIMELINE.csv sample is NOT authoritative Windows commit limit — it is the signature of reading one counter twice. The 3197151362 bytes SCW OOM allocation figure is unproven from available evidence; closest actual evidence is 1073741856 bytes (1 GiB) OOM in Session 1 with 9 workers.
